fields.english: Shadowguard

Something important is up in Orgrimmar, <name>.

The normal messengers that come through here looking for troll priests usually are very casual. This time, they seemed to be in much more a hurry. Don't dally too long in Thunder Bluff. I'd return to the Valley of Spirits as soon as possible.
Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
One of the most important rites of passage for a <class> of our faith is upon us, <name>. I will explain more to you--you are ready.
Shadowguard

Like many of our own priests, your own tribe puts you through rites of passage. These rites often teach priests special abilities that are vital to their survival. I sense that time is upon you even as we speak. You must return to the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar and speak to Ur'kyo. What he teaches you might be very important for the future.
Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
One of the most important rites of passage for a <class> of our faith is upon us, <name>. I will explain more to you--you are ready.
Shadowguard
Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.
Elune's Grace

By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
Elune's Grace

You know you have access to any of our trainers at any time, <name>, but there are some things that we cannot pass on to you. One of those things are the teachings of your goddess Elune. She gives special abilities to her faithful, and if I'm not mistaken, it is time for you to return home to your Temple of the Moon to be tested.

Return there when you can and speak to Priestess Alathea.
Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.

Elune bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
Elune's Grace

A wonderful day has come, <name>. You've reached the age in which our <priests/priestesses> are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you Elune's Grace.
Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.

Elune bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
Elune's Grace

Time's a wastin', <lad/lass>. It's time for you to return home to Darnassus. Priestess Alathea's sent word here that you're to return there for training. Seems they feel you're ready to be tested much like those who serve the Light. You should head out whenever you can. Alathea's message said that she'd be waitin' for you in the Temple of the Moon. Good luck.
Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
